description_en: You can call the DescribeQosPolicies operation to query the quintuple rule configurations for a Quality of Service (QoS) policy
description_zh: 调用DescribeQosPolicies查询QoS策略五元组规则配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-qos-policies --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-xitd8690ucu8ro0000 --qos-policy-id qospy-427m9fo6wkh0000 --description docdesc --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --priority 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeQosPolicies

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the QoS policy instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the QoS policy instance
parameters.name: qos_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the quintuple rule instance in the QoS policy
parameters.help_zh: QoS策略五元组规则的实例ID
parameters.name: qos_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the quintuple rule instance in the QoS policy.

The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略五元组规则实例的描述。

长度为1~512个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The number of quintuple rules to return on each page.

The default value is 10. The maximum value is 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页展示的五元组规则条目数。

默认值：10，最大值：50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the throttling rule to which the quintuple rule in the QoS policy belongs.

The priority range is 1 to 3. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

If you have submitted a ticket and created a priority-4 QoS policy by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131575.html operation, you can use this operation to query the configurations of quintuple rules for the priority-4 QoS policy
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略五元组规则所属的限速规则的优先级。

优先级范围：1~3。数值越小，优先级越高。

如果您已经提交工单申请并通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131575.html创建了第4优先级的QoS策略，您可以通过本接口查询第4优先级的QoS策略五元组规则配置信息
parameters.name: priority
